artifact_scope: Expanded post-V1 exploratory evidence with held-out G1 topology survey and 10-seed G3 risk-budget replication

g1_survey.hazard_pair_policy: all unordered free nonterminal cell pairs

G1_held_out_topology_interaction_survey.interpretation: Both dependence-sensitivity signs occur beyond the hand-built controls. The counts are a held-out mechanism survey, not an estimate of real-environment prevalence.

G3_risk_budget_replication.budget_exposure_ordering: mean exposures are nondecreasing from budget 5 to 20 to 50 in all 12 frozen p/threshold conditions
G3_risk_budget_replication.budget_failure_ordering: mean observed failures are nondecreasing from budget 5 to 20 to 50 in all 12 frozen p/threshold conditions
G3_risk_budget_replication.interpretation: The multi-seed replication confirms a stable information-risk frontier: larger explicit budgets produce more exposure and failures, and the largest tested budget improves mean estimation error in every frozen condition. Smaller budgets can fail to improve over a lucky prior in some conditions, so the result is not monotone superiority.

claim_gate_update.G1: ADVANCES FURTHER: exact two-hazard interaction identity plus held-out random-grid evidence that both signs occur. Main remaining gates are realistic execution validation and systematic literature review.
claim_gate_update.G3: TRADEOFF REPLICATED: explicit budgets break non-identification and improve estimation with increasing exposure/failure cost. Not a safe-learning solution and not standalone risk-budget novelty.
claim_gate_update.G5: STRONG COMPUTATIONAL COMPANION: exact quotient removes substantial reachable-state redundancy, while online A* speedup remains workload-dependent.

limitations: G1 random-grid counts are not population prevalence estimates
G3 remains a simplified single-critical-trigger model
G3 risk-budget charge is posterior/model-based and not a physical safety certificate
10 repetitions are exploratory replication rather than a preregistered confirmatory trial
no ROS/Gazebo or physical-robot evidence in this artifact
